set.acceptance: A test with a fake runner presses p then y on a ready change set and asserts one run.start call with args <cs> --workflow plan and no --autonomous, and the view says it queued the plan run; s then y gives one run.start with <cs> --autonomous --permission-mode auto; n calls nothing; o on a change set with a live run calls run.open and says which Rex tab it focused, and on one without says no live run; no test runs real Rex
set.statement: On the selected change set, p queues a plan run and s queues a ship run through run.start for the daemon to drive, the plan run interactive and the ship run autonomous with permission mode auto; the app asks y/n first, stays open, and says it queued the run for the daemon; o focuses the Rex tab of the change set's live run, or says there is none
